api.level: MapGenerator.generate(seed: seed, level: level, playerCount: players, reservedPassages: passages), passages given as [x, y, name] in order; a map is its seed, width, height, baseX, baseY, bases as [x, y], and cells: [index, content, lair, transitionBase, passageName] for each cell holding anything, index = y * width + x, lair as [difficulty, family, unitCount], transitionBase as [type, name], the trailing nulls left out (see the README)
api.world: WorldGenerator.generate(seed: seed, playerCount: players): the MapGenerationResult of levels 1, 2 and 3; a map is its seed, width, height, baseX, baseY, bases as [x, y], and cells: [index, content, lair, transitionBase, passageName] for each cell holding anything, index = y * width + x, lair as [difficulty, family, unitCount], transitionBase as [type, name], the trailing nulls left out (see the README)
